name: krunner-ai
description: Generate satu file .krunner yang berisi semua aturan AI coding (anti-slop + security-audit + Flutter standards) — bisa dibaca oleh AI mana pun.

scripts.sync-version: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { const v = fs.readFileSync('../VERSION', 'utf-8').trim().replace(/^v/i,''); const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf-8')); pkg.version = v; fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n'); console.log('Synced version to ' + v); });"

author: TheRabdal
